title: A Trust-Region Interior-Point Stochastic Sequential Quadratic Programming Method
abstract: arXiv:2603.10230v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a trust-region interior-point stochastic sequential quadratic programming (TR-IP-SSQP) method for solving optimization problems with a stochastic objective and deterministic nonlinear equality and inequality constraints. In this setting, exact evaluations of the objective function and its gradient are unavailable, but their stochastic estimates can be constructed. In particular, at each iteration our method builds stochastic oracles whose estimates of the objective value and gradient satisfy proper adaptive accuracy conditions with a fixed probability. To handle inequality constraints, we adopt an interior-point method (IPM), in which the barrier parameter is taken from a prescribed decreasing sequence and is reduced once a stochastic stationarity test is passed. Under standard assumptions, we show that, almost surely, the KKT residual vanishes along the iterations at which the barrier parameter is red

translated_title: 信赖域内点随机序贯二次规划方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种信赖域内点随机序贯二次规划（TR-IP-SSQP）方法，用于求解目标函数随机、等式与不等式约束为确定性非线性的优化问题。在该设定下，目标函数及其梯度的精确求值不可获得，但可以构造其随机估计。特别地，在每次迭代中，我们的方法构建随机预言机，其目标值与梯度的估计以固定概率满足适当的自适应精度条件。为处理不等式约束，我们采用内点法（IPM），其中障碍参数取自一个预先设定的递减序列，并且一旦通过随机平稳性检验，障碍参数就会被减小。在标准假设下，我们证明了在障碍参数减小的迭代点上，KKT残差几乎必然趋于零。
tldr: 本文提出一种信赖域内点随机序贯二次规划方法，利用满足自适应精度条件的随机估计和内点障碍策略求解随机目标加确定性非线性约束的优化问题，并证明了KKT残差几乎必然收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trust-region interior-point stochastic sequential quadratic programming method that uses stochastic oracles with adaptive accuracy and a barrier parameter reduction strategy to solve optimization problems with stochastic objectives and deterministic nonlinear constraints, proving almost sure convergence of the KKT residual.
